# Philip Le Sueur

Philip Le Sueur is the current Connétable of [Trinity](https://flow.je/elections/trinity) and was first elected to the States of Jersey in 2014.

Philip Le Sueur has participated in 3 elections since 2002:

- [**2014 Connétables Election**](https://flow.je/elections/candidates/philip-le-sueur#e21)

  Elected as Connétable of Trinity unopposed.
- [**2018 Connétables Election**](https://flow.je/elections/candidates/philip-le-sueur#e43)

  Elected as Connétable of Trinity unopposed.

  - [2018 Vote.je Manifesto](https://www.vote.je/candidates/2018/philip-le-sueur-3/)
- [**2022 Connétables Election**](https://flow.je/elections/candidates/philip-le-sueur#e49)

  Elected as Connétable of Trinity.

  - [2022 Vote.je Manifesto](https://www.vote.je/candidates/2022/philip-le-sueur/)
